column1: # The calls `aeiou-trace capture --source ebpf` traces on aarch64, and what each argument is
# (DESIGN_REVIEW.md §3.96 "Phase 3"): the set is strace 6.8's for the capture's line (capture.rs
# TRACE_SET: the classes %file, %desc, %process, %network and the calls named), its numbers and
# argument counts strace's own table (src/linux/64/syscallent.h and src/linux/generic/syscallent-common.h, v6.8);
# the kinds are this repository's, one letter per argument strace prints, `_` a raw argument it
# does not (src/ebpf.rs `Kind`). Columns: number, name, kinds.
